summary: Added the Projects | Files tabs to the expanded left sidebar and the two rail tab icons. SidebarTabs is a thin adapter over jattac.libs.web.zest-tabs (USR-001) that adds Enter/Space activation, an accessible name for the tab list and its own tab/pill/focus CSS, keeping the library's role=tablist/tab, aria-selected, roving tabindex, ArrowLeft/Right selection and a visible focus ring. SidebarProjects is a memoised extraction of the existing Home row plus app and terminal rows, so a tab switch only flips a hidden flag and the pill and never reconciles the (up to 500-row) list. The strip sits in a fixed top row beside the existing collapse button, the panels below it scroll, and the Files panel is mounted lazily on first use and kept afterwards, so opening on Projects reads no folder and returning to Files does not list again. The sidebar owns its own tab state; src/App.tsx, the explorer root rules and every selection handler are untouched, so selecting an app, terminal, Home or file never switches the tab. The rail keeps Expand, Home and the app initials with their dots and gains Projects and Files icon buttons that expand and select their tab in one handler, with the existing rail-active style on the current tab. Existing sidebar tests were reworked to the new tab placement and Projects default, and App.explorer.test.tsx now selects the Files tab before asserting on the explorer. Note: the repo's own App.version.test.tsx and the App.test.tsx footer assertion expect v2.3.0 while package.json/Cargo/tauri are 2.4.0 at HEAD, so those two assertions fail independently of this change (both files are outside this design's scope); App.updates.test.tsx is timing-flaky in the full run but passes alone. Slice 2 of the build: added the whole-window (App.explorer.test.tsx) coverage that completes R1, R3, R4 and A2 for revision 1. A new describe block drives the real App and proves: Projects is the default tab with only the Home row/apps/terminals visible and Files shows only the explorer filling the pane; with no apps but a folder the two tabs are still there; with no apps and no folder the sidebar stays hidden as today; switching tabs never changes the selected app, starts/stops a terminal, or changes the active editor file/tab/text; the collapsed rail's new Projects and Files icons expand the pane straight onto their tab in one click while Home and app initials keep today's behaviour and leave the tab alone; choosing Home from the palette or an app from the Home screen never switches the tab; and a delete that closes an editor tab keeps the sidebar on Files. A2 characterisation also pins the expanded Home row, app/terminal rows and roll-up dots and the rail's Expand/Home/initials with dots. No production code had to change; slice 1's Sidebar/SidebarTabs/SidebarProjects already implement this behaviour and all tests pass.
